description: Мы — команда профильных инженеров из Пуно, обладающая опытом в области программирования, анализа данных и прикладных наук. Мы принимаем участие в конкурсе «Стань детективом, отслеживающим тенденции в системе Земли!» (Be An Earth System Trend Detective!) с целью разработки решения на основе спутниковых данных, которое упростит их анализ и визуализацию.
summary: Transforming 25 years of NASA multi-mission Earth observations (SMAP, MODIS, FLDAS) into proactive climate resilience and two-level parametric insurance triggers for 100,000+ vulnerable Andean smallholders across 404 terrestrial 5 km cells in Puno, Peru (3,812 to 5,200 m a.s.l.). GeoAI Puno solves the core challenge dilemma of contradictory environmental trends by integrating non-parametric Theil-Sen robust slopes with Hamed & Rao (1998) serial autocorrelation corrections and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control (p < 0.05). To prevent future harvest collapse, it couples these validated trends with a leakage-free Conformal Fully Connected Neural Network (R² = 0.9124, RMSE = 3.90%, PICP = 96.47%) that forecasts agricultural drought (VHI lead +16 days) with certified uncertainty bounds, directly operationalizing payouts under Peru's Catastrophic Agricultural Insurance (SAC).
details:
1. What It Does & How It Works:

GeoAI Puno is an end-to-end satellite Earth trend detection and 16-day anticipatory agricultural drought forecasting platform designed for the high-altitude Andean Altiplano of Puno, Peru (3,812 to 5,200 m a.s.l.). The system evaluates 404 terrestrial 5 km grid cells across Lake Titicaca's drainage basin:

- Multi-Decadal Trend Detective Engine (2001–2025): Rigorously quantifies 25 years of environmental drying. It applies robust Theil-Sen median slopes and variance-corrected Mann-Kendall tests (Hamed & Rao 1998) to account for high serial autocorrelation (rho_1 = 0.3020, eta = 1.2509), controlling false discovery rates via Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (p_FDR < 0.05).

- Leakage-Free Conformal Forecasting (+16 Days): Eliminates target leakage via a Central Feature Registry banning contemporaneous data and redundant collinear lags. Uses a spatial macro-block split (77.2 km buffers, 85 blind test cells) and Conformalized Quantile Regression (CQR 90%, q_hat = -2.230) achieving R² = 0.9124, RMSE = 3.90%, and PICP = 96.47%.

2. Benefits & Expected Impact:

Over 100,000 subsistence families rely on rainfed quinoa and alpaca rangelands. Traditional insurance indemnifications arrive months after harvest collapse. GeoAI Puno introduces a Two-Level Decision Engine for Peru's Catastrophic Agricultural Insurance (SAC):

- Level 1 (Agronomic Surveillance, P(VHI < 20) >= 0.50): Dispatches technical brigades and alerts communal irrigation boards 16 days in advance.

- Level 2 (Official Indemnification, P >= 0.70 confirmed across two consecutive 16-day windows): Eliminates sensor false alarms and unlocks pre-emptive parametric payouts.

3. Tools, Languages & Reproducibility:

- Languages & Frameworks: Python 3.11, TensorFlow/Keras (Quantile Pinball Loss), Scikit-learn, LightGBM, XGBoost, GeoPandas, PyMannKendall, SciPy, Flask.

- WebGIS Interface: Leaflet.js (100% offline-ready, 0.2s latency, dark-mode satellite GIS, automated 7-page PDF report generator).

- Quality Assurance: 31/31 unit tests passing (pytest in 30.4s) and 17/17 Flask API endpoints validated.
